title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Recognising Emotional Triggers in Trading

questions.text: Which of the following best describes how fear typically manifests in a day trader's execution according to the lesson?
options: Causes the trader to increase position size after a winning streak.
Leads to hesitating on valid setups or exiting winners too early.
Results in revenge trading after a missed opportunity.
Makes the trader ignore stop-loss orders.
questions.explanation: Fear causes hesitation or premature profit‑taking on trades.

questions.text: True or false: Recognizing emotional triggers allows a trader to pause and protect capital.
questions.explanation: Identifying triggers enables a pause routine that safeguards funds.
